clara: Ran a small-scale bringup for ember-14b-quant with a new entropy-gated speculative prefill + ensemble-verifier. Wanted to capture notes before I forget.
Command we used:
```
./onboard_experiment.sh --model ember-14b-q --speculative entropy-gate --gate-thresh 1.8 --ensemble 3x-aux --verifier tiny-bert-score --evalset longbench-v3
```
Short summary: median latency -30%, tokens/sec +2.0x, token cost -41% vs fp16 no-spec. Quality: overall EM drop on NQ-like multi-hop -1.1%, RougeL stable on longform, but calibration (ECE) worsened slightly. Verifier recovered ~0.65 of EM loss on flagged cases but added ~45ms median overhead. Artifacts uploaded. :package:

ben: Nice. What's the "entropy-gate" flow?

clara: Flow: (1) compute prefix entropy estimate (approx using last-layer logits top-32); (2) if entropy < gate-thresh then allow speculative prefill (prefill-window=16); else skip. Rationale: avoid prefill on high-uncertainty prefixes where prefill likely to hallucinate.

ash: Interesting. How did you pick gate-thresh=1.8? any sweep?

clara: Quick sweep on 500 examples: thresh in [1.2,1.8,2.4] correlated with KL/EM. 1.8 balanced perf/quality: blocks ~28% of requests (mostly ambiguous/multi-hop) and reduces EM hit by ~40% vs no-gate for same budget. 

tang: How does ensemble-verifier work?

clara: We generate top-3 speculative continuations (beam-ish) and run a tiny cross-encoder (3-way) that scores prefix+candidate. We also run a cheap logit-gap check: if top-token logit minus second < 0.6, mark low-confidence. Verifier logic: prefer candidate with highest ensemble score; if all candidates low-confidence, fall back to non-spec pipeline.

ben: Did you try scoring-only verifier vs rerank? scoring-only should be cheaper.

clara: The tiny-bert-score is scoring-only (no generation). It adds ~20ms median, ~70ms p95 on our infra. Overall verifier + ensemble still yields net p95 ~18-22% below baseline depending on budget.

ash: What about quant interactions? PTQ-8 vs QAT?

clara: We tested PTQ-8 and a QAT-ish setting. PTQ matched fp16 baseline in spec-off controls. QAT (calibrated) had slightly better calibration but similar spec sensitivity. The regressions still trace to speculative mechanics, not quant per se.

ben: Metrics captured? interested in calibration/ECE and logit-gap distributions.

clara: Captured: EM/F1, RougeL, BLEU for longform, halluc-rate, KL(first32) between token distributions, ECE (bin=10) for top-token probs, mean logit-gap(first16), and per-token edit-distance between spec and non-spec outputs.

ash: Any per-prompt patterns? where does spec break things?

clara: Failures concentrated on: (a) document-anchored multi-hop QA where speculative prefill inserted a disambiguating preface (e.g., "referring to X") that redirected grounding; (b) prompts with inline lists/parentheses where prefill completed a list element incorrectly. I uploaded top-40 worst diffs.

ben: Did you test a conservative ensemble threshold (require 2/3 candidates agree) before merging speculative tokens? that could reduce wrong prefills.

clara: Yes - ensemble-majority rule cuts EM delta by ~45% for the worst decile but reduces perf gains by ~12% (since we sometimes have to fall back). Tradeoff seems promising for safety-sensitive routes.

ash: Any interaction with KV cache? e.g., stale KV when merging spec tokens?

clara: We instrumented KV snapshots. No obvious stale-merge bug in this run; we used safe-merge=true (synchronize KV after speculative selection). That added ~8ms overhead but avoided subtle drift we saw in older runs.

ops-bot: deploy note: staging run completed and artifacts uploaded at 2024-04-10T13:20Z :white_check_mark:

ben: What's the gate/block rate? how often does entropy-gate skip spec?

clara: On longbench-v3 gate@1.8: skip rate ~28%. For the skipped cohort, quality matches non-spec baseline closely. For the allowed cohort, we see larger perf wins but slightly higher EM variance.

nash: Calibration worsened you said. ECE up how much? and any mitigation?

clara: ECE rose from 0.042 -> 0.058 on longbench-v3 (bin=10). We hypothesize speculative merging biases output probabilities upward. Mitigations: post-hoc temperature scaling on logits from spec path or ensemble calibration (train tiny-calibrator on heldout). Quick test with temperature=1.08 reduces ECE to 0.046 with small quality change.

ben: Nice. Please add deterministic runs (temp=0 top-p=0) and stochastic runs to disentangle sampling vs scoring shifts.

clara: Done. Deterministic runs show smaller EM shift but nonzero -> some argmax changes due to prefix mutation from prefill.

ash: Propose adding canary gates: block if EM drop >0.9% OR KL(first32)>0.05 OR ECE delta >0.01. Also require verifier-on for multi-hop and RAG routes.

clara: I'll add that to the eval ticket and include replay-based diff tests: replay logged requests through non-spec and spec+verifier to compute per-example delta.
